title: Add failed-turn diagnostic trace outside canon rollback
description:
Persist minimal diagnostics for failed turns without allowing failed model/tool work to mutate canon.

Successful turns already persist trace/transcript/tool/context data. Failed turns currently roll back canon, which is correct, but the failure details can be lost after the CLI exits. Add a non-canon diagnostic path for debugging failures.

## Context
Observed gap:
- The turn loop uses rollback/savepoint semantics to protect canon on failure.
- Failed turns return ok:false and an error in memory, but durable failure diagnostics are limited or absent.
- This makes provider/tool/protocol failures harder to debug after the process exits.

Parallel-safety:
- Does not overlap SRD importer parser beads.
- Avoid starting this at the same time as a broad orchestrator/persistence source-layout refactor.
- Keep schema change small and targeted.
design:
Suggested files to inspect:
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts
- packages/core/src/storage/*
- packages/core/src/*trace* or equivalent trace/persistence code
- tests around failed model turns, tool failures, savepoint rollback, transcript persistence

Implementation guidance:
1. Preserve current canon rollback behavior.
2. Add a diagnostic record that is written after rollback or through a non-canon diagnostic channel.
3. Persist only safe/minimal fields:
   - campaign/session/turn identifiers if available
   - timestamp
   - error name/class
   - sanitized message
   - model round count
   - phase/stage if available
4. Do not persist provider secrets, API keys, raw env, or sensitive request metadata.
5. Add tests that intentionally fail a model/tool call:
   - canon/transcript/tool side effects are rolled back
   - diagnostic record remains available
6. Keep naming clear that this is diagnostic/non-canon, not game history.
acceptance_criteria:
- Failed model/tool/protocol turn produces a durable non-canon diagnostic record.
- Failed turn still rolls back canon mutations, transcript mutations, and tool-result mutations as currently intended.
- Diagnostic record excludes provider secrets and raw sensitive env/config values.
- Tests cover at least one failed model path and one failed tool/protocol path if feasible.
- Existing successful-turn behavior is unchanged.
- No SRD importer parser files are modified.
close_reason: Failed-turn non-canon diagnostics implemented; canon/transcript/trace rollback preserved; verification npm run test, npm run typecheck, and npm run check passed; TDD evidence recorded in child beads.
